## Summary and General Analysis
- Yanqing is a Single Target DPS who uses a combination of Skill, Ultimate and Follow-Up ATK.
- In order to maintain Soulsteel Sync, Yanqing must not take direct damage from enemies. As a result, you should often use a sustain that can provide Shield.
- Small advantage against enemies with Ice Weakness and enemies that are Frozen.

## Investment Priority
 ### Support Investments > E4
- E4 increases his Ice RES PEN 
- You would see greater improvements by investing into his supports, as his own eidolons do not provide a significant improvement to his performance.

## Abillity Rotation
- Skill spam. Basic ATK only if necessary, ideally using Ultimate immediately after to maintain Soulsteel Sync
